scientific_integrity: The human-readable proof includes a general cubic upper bound and separate rigorous equality classifications; computational checks are independently replayable and confined to the two explicitly finite instances.
scientific_limitations: Only the exact two finite incidence graphs H and D are covered. The finite independent verifier enumerates every maximum packing; the analytical extremal classification uses their precise incidence structures. No statement about other cubic or bipartite graphs is made. Historical equivalence under induced-star-forest or injective-edge-color terminology cannot be eliminated by finite bibliographical searches.
title: Edge-open-packing rigidity in the Heawood and Desargues incidence graphs
